dialogues.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
dialogues.text: As the Demoiselle's partner and esteemed benefactor of the Spina di Rosula, you, too, are my superior. Please, what would you have me do?

choices.text: Just make sure you do a good job.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: That is a matter of course. I will treat every animal in this manor with the same care and attention as I did when serving Monsieur Consigliere.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: I merely thought that you might have some additional requirements. For example... That I assist our guests in conversing with the animals, so that they may better understand their viewpoints...

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: Though I may be busy, if you were to have such a requirement, I have... brothers I can call. You wouldn't need to pay another Mora more.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: Why, thank you for the compliment!

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: You have a certain coldness to you, you stand tall and straight — perhaps you, too, might suit... the more solemn attire that we favor in the Spina di Rosula.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: Were you to dress all in black, with a pair of dark glasses, and conspicuously display your formidable approach throughout the land... I'm sure you could gather your own group of loyal disciples.

choices.text: I'll be going. Stay focused on the job at hand.

response.speaker: Consigliere's Ex-Left Hand
response.text: As you ordain. I won't take up any more of your time!
